user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otelcol_distribution: otelcol-contrib
    otelcol_version: "0.99.0"
    otelcol_exporter_endpoint: "otlp.example.com:4317"
    otelcol_otlp_listen_address: "0.0.0.0:4317"
    otelcol_user: otelcol
    otelcol_group: otelcol
    otelcol_config_dir: /etc/otelcol
    otelcol_config_path: /etc/otelcol/config.yaml
    otelcol_state_dir: /var/lib/otelcol
    otelcol_log_dir: /var/log/otelcol
    otelcol_install_base: /opt/otelcol
    otelcol_bin_dir: /usr/local/bin
    otelcol_service_name: otelcol
    otelcol_service_unit_path: /etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service
    otelcol_tls_insecure: false
    otelcol_headers: {}
    otelcol_queue_size: 5120
    otelcol_retry_initial_interval: 1s
    otelcol_retry_max_interval: 30s
    otelcol_retry_max_elapsed_time: 300s
    arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
      arm64: arm64
      amd64: amd64

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure exporter endpoint is specified
      assert:
        that:
          - otelcol_exporter_endpoint is defined
          - otelcol_exporter_endpoint | length > 0
        fail_msg: "Variable 'otelcol_exporter_endpoint' must be defined and non-empty."

    - name: Determine architecture
      set_fact:
        otelcol_arch: "{{ arch_map.get(ansible_architecture, 'amd64') }}"

    - name: Set derived variables
      set_fact:
        otelcol_release_filename: "{{ otelcol_distribution }}_{{ otelcol_version }}_linux_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
        otelcol_release_url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/{{ otelcol_release_filename }}"
        otelcol_checksums_url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}/checksums.txt"
        otelcol_version_dir: "{{ otelcol_install_base }}/{{ otelcol_distribution }}-{{ otelcol_version }}-linux-{{ otelcol_arch }}"
        otelcol_binary_path: "{{ otelcol_version_dir }}/{{ otelcol_distribution }}"
        otelcol_symlink_path: "{{ otelcol_bin_dir }}/otelcol"

  tasks:
    - name: Create group
      group:
        name: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create user
      user:
        name: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: "{{ otelcol_state_dir }}"
        create_home: false

    - name: Create directories
      file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ item.owner | default('root') }}"
        group: "{{ item.group | default('root') }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0755') }}"
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_install_base }}", mode: "0755" }
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_version_dir }}", mode: "0755" }
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}", mode: "0750", group: "{{ otelcol_group }}" }
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_state_dir }}", owner: "{{ otelcol_user }}", group: "{{ otelcol_group }}", mode: "0750" }
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_log_dir }}", owner: "{{ otelcol_user }}", group: "{{ otelcol_group }}", mode: "0750" }

    - name: Fetch checksums manifest
      uri:
        url: "{{ otelcol_checksums_url }}"
        return_content: true
      register: otelcol_checksums

    - name: Extract checksum for release file
      set_fact:
        otelcol_sha256_line: "{{ (otelcol_checksums.content.splitlines() | select('search', otelcol_release_filename) | list | first) | default('') }}"
    - name: Fail if checksum not found
      fail:
        msg: "Could not find checksum for {{ otelcol_release_filename }} in checksums file."
      when: otelcol_sha256_line | length == 0

    - name: Derive SHA256 from checksum line
      set_fact:
        otelcol_sha256: "{{ otelcol_sha256_line.split()[0] | lower }}"

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector archive
      get_url:
        url: "{{ otelcol_release_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otelcol_release_filename }}"
        mode: '0644'
        checksum: "sha256:{{ otelcol_sha256 }}"

    - name: Unarchive OpenTelemetry Collector
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ otelcol_release_filename }}"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_version_dir }}"
        remote_src: true
        creates: "{{ otelcol_binary_path }}"

    - name: Ensure collector binary permissions
      file:
        path: "{{ otelcol_binary_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Symlink collector to a stable path
      file:
        src: "{{ otelcol_binary_path }}"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_symlink_path }}"
        state: link
        force: true
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Write OpenTelemetry Collector config
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_config_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: '0640'
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: "{{ otelcol_otlp_listen_address }}"

          processors:
            memory_limiter:
              check_interval: 5s
              limit_percentage: 75
              spike_limit_percentage: 15
            batch: {}

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otelcol_exporter_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otelcol_tls_insecure | ternary('true', 'false') }}
              {% if otelcol_headers is mapping and otelcol_headers|length > 0 %}
              headers:
              {% for k, v in otelcol_headers.items() %}
                {{ k }}: "{{ v }}"
              {% endfor %}
              {% endif %}
              compression: gzip
              sending_queue:
                enabled: true
                queue_size: {{ otelcol_queue_size }}
              retry_on_failure:
                enabled: true
                initial_interval: {{ otelcol_retry_initial_interval }}
                max_interval: {{ otelcol_retry_max_interval }}
                max_elapsed_time: {{ otelcol_retry_max_elapsed_time }}

          service:
            telemetry:
              logs:
                level: "info"
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Validate OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      command: "{{ otelcol_symlink_path }} --config {{ otelcol_config_path }} --dry-run"
      register: otelcol_validate
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create systemd unit for OpenTelemetry Collector
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_service_unit_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otelcol_user }}
          Group={{ otelcol_group }}
          ExecStart={{ otelcol_symlink_path }} --config {{ otelcol_config_path }}
          WorkingDirectory={{ otelcol_state_dir }}
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=2
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          ReadWritePaths={{ otelcol_state_dir }} {{ otelcol_log_dir }}
          AmbientCapabilities=
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          SystemCallFilter=@system-service

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Reload systemd and enable/start OpenTelemetry Collector
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otelcol_service_name }}"
        daemon_reload: true
        enabled: true
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: restart otelcol
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otelcol_service_name }}"
        state: restarted

                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Validate OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      command: "{{ otelcol_symlink_path }} --config {{ otelcol_config_path }} --dry-run"
      register: otelcol_validate
      changed_when: false

    - name: Create systemd unit for OpenTelemetry Collector
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_service_unit_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otelcol_user }}
          Group={{ otelcol_group }}
          ExecStart={{ otelcol_symlink_path }} --config {{ otelcol_config_path }}
          WorkingDirectory={{ otelcol_state_dir }}
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=2
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          ReadWritePaths={{ otelcol_state_dir }} {{ otelcol_log_dir }}
          AmbientCapabilities=
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          SystemCallFilter=@system-service

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify: restart otelcol

    - name: Reload systemd and enable/start OpenTelemetry Collector
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otelcol_service_name }}"
        daemon_reload: true
        enabled: true
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: restart otelcol
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otelcol_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
